note: morph_id is globally unique and identical in every pack that contains the morph (so packs that are subsets of one another share IDs by design). morph_id_range is the min/max of the ALLOCATED blocks of the pack's categories; use morph_id_ranges_by_category for the exact blocks and morph_id_map.json for id->source-target. Phase 10: morphs are AFMT v2 (i16-quantized deltas) and packs are built with content-hash dedup on by default (masking the embedded per-blob morph_id, which is never read at load time -- see PHASE_10_MERGE_NOTES.md). phase8_size_bytes and phase10_vs_phase8_ratio on each pack record the prior Phase 8 (v1, no dedup) baseline for comparison.

packs.label: Essentials
packs.description: Core body macro sliders (age, weight, muscle, gender, height family): MakeHuman's whole-population targets. Fewest morphs, and now the pack with the single largest byte reduction in Phase 10 (v2 quantization + content-hash dedup: 348 morphs collapse to 145 unique blobs, largely symmetric/paired macrodetail targets sharing identical deltas).

packs.label: Body shape
packs.description: Body proportion and build variety (macro sliders, arms/legs, body shapes, torso, neck, hip, stomach, pelvis, buttocks, breast, genitals). No face. 806 morphs dedup to 548 unique blobs.

packs.label: Face shape
packs.description: Facial identity variety (head, nose, ears, mouth, cheek, chin, forehead, eyebrows, eyes, asymmetry). No duplicate blobs in this pack (332/332) -- the size drop here is purely the Phase 10 v2 i16 quantization.

packs.label: Expressions
packs.description: POSED FACIAL EXPRESSIONS (smile, frown, etc.). Not shape/identity diversity: a different purpose from the body-shape and face-shape packs -- present it as its own picker category, not blended with them. 102 morphs dedup to 67 unique blobs.

packs.label: Measurement fit
packs.description: Targets suited to a future 'type in real height/waist/chest, reverse-fit' feature. Kept separate so that feature can load just this small pack. No duplicate blobs in this pack (40/40).

packs.label: Full library
packs.description: The entire MakeHuman CC0 target corpus, unfiltered (all 23 categories). Power-user / offline option; not a default download. 1,280 morphs dedup to 985 unique blobs.
